summaries.Good news: Today's uplifting stories celebrate resilience and recovery: a life-saving housing design reducing malaria by 44%, dogs catching waves at surf competitions, and ospreys making a remarkable comeback in Britain after a century of extinction.
summaries.Ideas: From AI safety reckoning at OpenAI to practical post-quantum cryptography, today's insights explore how organizations are grappling with AI's transformative power, surveillance ethics, and the human skills that will matter most as automation accelerates.
summaries.Technology: A world's-largest electric aircraft takes flight, Nissan breaks fuel-economy records, and robotics innovation spans from folding robot-arm phones to portable car-washing devices—showing how breakthrough engineering is reshaping mobility and daily life.
summaries.Design: Housing design emerges as a public health tool in Tanzania, while architecture studios reimagine civic landmarks and educational spaces; simultaneously, minimal aesthetic principles and sustainable material innovation shape everything from kitchens to hotels.
